#### An arrow diagram of words and letters

@fig-word-letters is the arrow diagram (@def-arrow-diagram) of the relation $H$ of @exm-word-letters.
Each of the five pairs of $H$ is one arrow.
Two arrows leave cat, and two arrive at o.

::: {#fig-word-letters}

The arrow diagram of the relation $H$ from the words $W$ to the letters $L$ they contain.
